name: WABIAN-2
summary: The 2006 model of Waseda's long-running WABIAN (WAseda BIpedal humANoid) line, built to emulate human walking closely enough to serve as a test bed for gait analysis and rehabilitation devices. With a powered pelvis and stretch-knee, heel-contact-to-toe-off gait, WABIAN-2 walks far more like a person than the stiff-legged crouch typical of earlier bipeds.
notable: Used as a platform to evaluate walk-assist devices

sources.title: Takanishi Laboratory, Waseda University — WABIAN research
